[b][u]LAVIAN NATIONAL HEALTH DEPARTMENT ANNOUNCEMENT:[/u][/b]

Attention all citizens! Due to the emergence of a new highly infectious disease, tourist areas and towns are now under quarantine. If you are a tourist visiting Lavia or live somewhere else than where you are currently, please return home and quarantine yourself as soon as possible. Most cities will remain operating as normal, however there will be implementation of temporary mask mandates and if you suspect you are infected with this new virus, please contact your local hospital for quarantine measures and to schedule a visit.

Due to the symptoms of fever, headache, and the filling of the lungs with fluid, the experts suspect it may be a mutation of the H1V1 influenza virus that ravaged Erene in the early 20th century or even a mutated version of Pneumonia, which ravaged the world in the same time frame. Scientists and medical experts are currently working on studying confirmed patients of what the media calls Llyndorian Flu, and we hope to inform the public of developments in a vaccine for the new virus soon.

Please stay safe, wear a mask, and quarantine if necessary. You will be informed if you are inside a quarantine zone soon, and if so, please ensure that you have necessary government identification needed for additional food aid during this crisis.

[b]Flight 4307 (Bristol, LLYN-Mitremtion, LMDA):[/b]

After a flight arrived from the Llyndorran capital of Bristol to Mitremtion Bitonio World Airport, many arriving passengers were reported to appear very sick, coughing everywhere in the airport and some collapsing to the floor. Due to the events in Lamandica one week ago today, many people suspected another terrorist attack. However, this was debunked when passengers reported feeling sick before boarding. Unfortunately, many of the passengers coughing spread onto others at the airport, sending many to the hospital and causing a complete closure of Terminals 2 & 3. After news of this event, as well as another similar one at Wichenvidence Woyeene International Airport, it was confirmed that a brand new virus that originated from Llyndorria has entered into Lamandica.

Due to this, the Lamandican government has announced a plan to combat this. For only the third time in Lamandicas 300 year history, with the Lamandican Constabulary enforcing it (but its the Lamandican Constabulary, so probably nothing will come from it), Lamandica will close all its borders. All flights will be grounded. Provinces have been ordered to construct makeshift outdoor quarantine and testing sites. Also due to the virus originating in Lamandica from Wichenvidence and Mitremtion, many medical teams will be stationed there for the foreseeable future. Moreover, the government has also sent medical teams to the major cities of Taultion, Port Encrastle, Tenahaston, and Tuergaulle to help prevent the spread of the disease to these major population centres, with them enforcing mask mandates while also making travel for nonessentials much more daunting with roadblocks on national highways and ordering the closure of various different stores, such as dispensaries for (recreational, not medical), firework shops, nail salons, etc.

[i][u][b]Inside the President's Conference Room[/b][/u][/i]

President Khan and his Healthcare Minister Pourezza sit at a distance as they discuss the sudden pandemic that swept the country.

"Does the Ministry of Healthcare have any plans or preparations for such an event?" Asks President Khan, not wearing a mask.

"No, the old government had preparations for outbreaks of some known diseases but nothing for a pandemic of this magnitude." Says Minister Pourezza through his face mask.

"So it falls on us to find a solution and fast. What plans and ideas do you have?"

"I have already ordered my Ministry to create a taskforce to develop a cure, ordered all hospital staff to wear masks and gloves at all times, and ordered them to be prepared for an influx of patients. I have also prepared a few plans and ideas which I can't enact but want you to consider." Minister Pourezza reads aloud a document that presents ideas for a national lockdown, mandatory face masks and gloves, and military hospitals to be used.

"None of this is good." President Khan says after a few minutes of thinking. "For the time being, I will make make a national announcement telling people to wear masks, gloves, and sanitise compulsively and warn that locdowns might be necessary." He rubs his temples before continuing, "If things continue this way, I will consider these measures. I won't rush this, it will be unpopular and threaten the successes I've made. That will be all."

With that, Minister Pourezza leaves President Khan alone in the conference room.
